from collections import Counter
def f(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for row in g for v in row)
    top,_=cnt.most_common(1)[0]
    div=None;orient=None
    for i,row in enumerate(g):
        if len(set(row))==1 and row[0]!=top: div=('h',i,row[0]); break
    if div is None:
        for j in range(w):
            col=[g[i][j] for i in range(h)]
            if len(set(col))==1 and col[0]!=top: div=('v',j,col[0]); break
    sh=set(cnt)-{top,div[2]}
    scells=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j] in sh]
    rows=[i for i,_ in scells]; cols=[j for _,j in scells]
    cr=(min(rows)+max(rows))/2; cc=(min(cols)+max(cols))/2
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    if div[0]=='h':
        pos=int(round(2*cr-div[1]))
        for j in range(w): out[pos][j]=8
    else:
        pos=int(round(2*cc-div[1]))
        for i in range(h): out[i][pos]=8
    return out

import os,re,json
d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
    k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
    rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
    if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
        G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
from collections import Counter
def f(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for row in g for v in row)
    top,_=cnt.most_common(1)[0]
    div=None;orient=None
    for i,row in enumerate(g):
        if len(set(row))==1 and row[0]!=top: div=('h',i,row[0]); break
    if div is None:
        for j in range(w):
            col=[g[i][j] for i in range(h)]
            if len(set(col))==1 and col[0]!=top: div=('v',j,col[0]); break
    sh=set(cnt)-{top,div[2]}
    scells=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j] in sh]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    if div[0]=='h':
        rows=[i for i,_ in scells]
        pos = max(rows)+1 if min(rows)>div[1] else min(rows)-1
        for j in range(w): out[pos][j]=8
    else:
        cols=[j for _,j in scells]
        pos = min(cols)-1
        for i in range(h): out[i][pos]=8
    return out
print("demo1:", f(G['Demo pair 1 input'])==G['Demo pair 1 output'])
print("demo2:", f(G['Demo pair 2 input'])==G['Demo pair 2 output'])
res=f(G['Test input']); print(json.dumps(res))

def f(inp):
    O=[r[:] for r in inp]; H,W=len(O),len(O[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(v for r in O for v in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    line=None;axis=None;div=None
    for c in range(W):
        if len({O[r][c] for r in range(H)})==1 and O[0][c]!=bg:
            line=c; axis='v'; div=O[0][c]; break
    if line is None:
        for r in range(H):
            if len({O[r][c] for c in range(W)})==1 and O[r][0]!=bg:
                line=r; axis='h'; div=O[r][0]; break
    obj=[(r,c,O[r][c]) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if O[r][c]!=bg and O[r][c]!=div]
    out=[[bg]*W for _ in range(H)]
    if axis=='v':
        for r in range(H): out[r][line]=div
        cols=sorted(set(c for _,c,_ in obj))
        shift=line+1-min(cols)      # move flush to divider (left)
        far=max(cols)+shift+1       # adjacent far side
        # try: bar on near side of object (between obj and div): far = min(cols)+shift-1? no
        # option A: far side of moved object
        for r,c,v in obj: out[r][c+shift]=v
        for r in range(H): out[r][far]=8
    else:
        for c in range(W): out[line][c]=div
        rows=sorted(set(r for r,_,_ in obj))
        shift=min(rows)-line-1
        far=max(rows)+shift+1
        for r,c,v in obj: out[r+shift][c]=v
        for c in range(W): out[far][c]=8
    return out

def f(inp):
    O=[r[:] for r in inp]; H,W=len(O),len(O[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(v for r in O for v in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    line=None;axis=None;div=None
    for c in range(W):
        if len({O[r][c] for r in range(H)})==1 and O[0][c]!=bg:
            line=c; axis='v'; div=O[0][c]; break
    if line is None:
        for r in range(H):
            if len({O[r][c] for c in range(W)})==1 and O[r][0]!=bg:
                line=r; axis='h'; div=O[r][0]; break
    obj=[(r,c,O[r][c]) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if O[r][c]!=bg and O[r][c]!=div]
    out=[[bg]*W for _ in range(H)]
    if axis=='v':
        for r in range(H): out[r][line]=div
        cols=sorted(set(c for _,c,_ in obj))
        # object left/right of divider; keep side, flush
        if min(cols)<line: shift=line-cols[0]-1
        else: shift=line-cols[-1]+1
        far=max(cols)+shift+1
        for r,c,v in obj: out[r][c+shift]=v
        for r in range(H): out[r][far]=8
    else:
        for c in range(W): out[line][c]=div
        rows=sorted(set(r for r,_,_ in obj))
        # above or below; keep side, flush
        if max(rows)>line: shift=line-rows[-1]-1
        else: shift=min(rows)-line-1
        far=min(rows)+shift+1 if max(rows)<=line else max(rows)+shift+1
        for r,c,v in obj: out[r+shift][c]=v
        for c in range(W): out[far][c]=8

def f(inp):
    O=[r[:] for r in inp]; H,W=len(O),len(O[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(v for r in O for v in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    line=None;axis=None;div=None
    for c in range(W):
        if len({O[r][c] for r in range(H)})==1 and O[0][c]!=bg:
            line=c; axis='v'; div=O[0][c]; break
    if line is None:
        for r in range(H):
            if len({O[r][c] for c in range(W)})==1 and O[r][0]!=bg:
                line=r; axis='h'; div=O[r][0]; break
    obj=[(r,c,O[r][c]) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if O[r][c]!=bg and O[r][c]!=div]
    out=[[bg]*W for _ in range(H)]
    if axis=='v':
        for r in range(H): out[r][line]=div
        cols=sorted(set(c for _,c,_ in obj))
        side='left' if cols[0]<line else 'right'
        if side=='left': shift=line-cols[-1]-1   # rightmost col flush to left of divider
        else: shift=line-cols[0]+1               # leftmost col flush to right of divider
        far=max(cols)+shift+1 if side=='right' else min(cols)+shift-1
        for r,c,v in obj: out[r][c+shift]=v
        for r in range(H): out[r][far]=8
    else:
        for c in range(W): out[line][c]=div
        rows=sorted(set(r for r,_,_ in obj))
        side='above' if rows[-1]<line else 'below'
        if side=='above': shift=line-rows[-1]-1
        else: shift=min(rows)-line-1
        far=min(rows)+shift-1 if side=='above' else max(rows)+shift+1
        for r,c,v in obj: out[r+shift][c]=v
        for c in range(W): out[far][c]=8
    return out

def f(inp):
    O=[r[:] for r in inp]; H,W=len(O),len(O[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(v for r in O for v in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    line=None;axis=None;div=None
    for c in range(W):
        if len({O[r][c] for r in range(H)})==1 and O[0][c]!=bg:
            line=c; axis='v'; div=O[0][c]; break
    if line is None:
        for r in range(H):
            if len({O[r][c] for c in range(W)})==1 and O[r][0]!=bg:
                line=r; axis='h'; div=O[r][0]; break
    cells=[(r,c,O[r][c]) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if O[r][c]!=bg and O[r][c]!=div]
    out=[[bg]*W for _ in range(H)]
    if axis=='v':
        for r in range(H): out[r][line]=div
        cols=sorted(set(c for _,c,_ in cells))
        if cols[0]<line:   # left of divider
            s=(cols[0])-line-1           # negative: move right until leftmost at line+1
            w=max(cols)-min(cols)+1      # keep shape compacted? or use min col directly: shift = line-cols[-1]+1 ??
            shift=line-max(cols)+1       # rightmost col flush to line-1... hmm ambiguous
            # choose: entire bbox translated so its NEAR edge (closest to line) is adjacent
            near=max(cols)               # left side: near edge = max col
            shift=line-near-1
        else:
            near=min(cols)
            shift=line-near+1            # near edge adjacent to line
        for r,c,v in cells: out[r][c+shift]=v
        far=max(cols)+shift+1 if cols[0]>line else min(cols)+shift-1
        for r in range(H): out[r][far]=8
    else:
        for c in range(W): out[line][c]=div
        rows=sorted(set(r for r,_,_ in cells))
        if rows[-1]<line:   # above
            near=max(rows)
            shift=line-near-1
        else:
            near=min(rows)
            shift=near-line-1
        for r,c,v in cells: out[r+shift][c]=v
        far=max(rows)+shift+1 if rows[-1]>line else min(rows)+shift-1
        for c in range(W): out[far][c]=8
    return out

def f(inp):
    O=[r[:] for r in inp]; H,W=len(O),len(O[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(v for r in O for v in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    line=None;axis=None;div=None
    for c in range(W):
        if len({O[r][c] for r in range(H)})==1 and O[0][c]!=bg:
            line=c; axis='v'; div=O[0][c]; break
    if line is None:
        for r in range(H):
            if len({O[r][c] for c in range(W)})==1 and O[r][0]!=bg:
                line=r; axis='h'; div=O[r][0]; break
    cells=[(r,c,O[r][c]) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if O[r][c]!=bg and O[r][c]!=div]
    out=[[bg]*W for _ in range(H)]
    if axis=='v':
        for r in range(H): out[r][line]=div
        cols=sorted(set(c for _,c,_ in cells))
        if cols[0]>line:   # object right of divider: near edge at line+1
            near=min(cols)
            s=(line+1)-near
        else:               # left of divider: far edge adjacent to line
            far=max(cols)
            s=(line-1)-far
        for r,c,v in cells: out[r][c+s]=v
        b=(max(cols)+s+1) if cols[0]>line else (min(cols)+s-1)
        for r in range(H): out[r][b]=8
    else:
        for c in range(W): out[line][c]=div
        rows=sorted(set(r for r,_,_ in cells))
        if rows[0]>line:    # below divider
            near=min(rows)
            s=(line+1)-near
        else:
            far=max(rows)
            s=(line-1)-far
        for r,c,v in cells: out[r+s][c]=v
        b=(max(rows)+s+1) if rows[0]>line else (min(rows)+s-1)
        for c in range(W): out[b][c]=8
    return out

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))

def f(inp):
    O=[r[:] for r in inp]; H,W=len(O),len(O[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(v for r in O for v in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # find divider: uniform non-bg full line/col
    hline=[r for r in O if len(set(r))==1 and r[0]!=bg]
    vcols=[c for c in range(W) if len({O[r][c] for r in range(H)})==1 and O[0][c]!=bg]
    axis='h' if hline else 'v'; line=hline[0][0] if hline else vcols[0]; div=O[line][0] if axis=='h' else O[0][line]
    cells=[(r,c,O[r][c]) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if O[r][c]!=bg and O[r][c]!=div]
    out=[[bg]*W for _ in range(H)]
    if axis=='h':
        for c in range(W): out[line][c]=div
        rows=sorted(set(r for _,_,_ in cells)); cols=sorted(set(c for _,_,_ in cells))
        if rows[0]>line:   # below: move up, near = top edge -> line+1
            s=line+1-min(rows)
            for r,c,v in cells: out[r+s][c]=v
            b=max(rows)+s+1       # bar below object (away from divider)
        else:               # above: move down, near = bottom edge -> line-1
            s=line-1-max(rows)
            for r,c,v in cells: out[r+s][c]=v
            b=min(rows)+s-1       # bar above object
        for c in range(W): out[b][c]=8
    else:
        for r in range(H): out[r][line]=div
        if min(c for _,_,_ in cells)>line:   # right of divider
            s=line+1-min(c for _,_,_ in cells)
            for r,c,v in cells: out[r][c+s]=v
            b=max(c for _,_,_ in cells)+s+1   # bar to the right (away from divider)
        else:
            s=line-1-max(c for _,_,_ in cells)
            for r,c,v in cells: out[r][c+s]=v
            b=min(c for _,_,_ in cells)+s-1   # bar to the left (away from divider)
        for r in range(H): out[r][b]=8
    return out

print([f(G[f'Demo pair {i} input'])==G[f'Demo pair {i} output'] for i in range(4,9)])
print(json.dumps(f(G['Test input'])))

import collections, json
def f(g):
    cnt=collections.Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    axis=line=None
    # detect vertical divider first, then horizontal (prefer existing line)
    for c in range(W):
        col=[g[r][c] for r in range(H)]
        if len(set(col))==1 and col[0]!=bg:
            axis='v'; line=c; break
    if axis is None:
        for r in range(H):
            if all(g[r][c]==g[r][0] for c in range(W)) and g[r][0]!=bg:
                axis='h'; line=r; break
    div=g[g[line]] if axis=='h' else [g[r][line] for r in range(H)][0]
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]!=div and g[r][c]!=bg]
    if not cells: return out
    # move object toward divider: nearest edge adjacent to line
    if axis=='h':
        minr=min(r for r,_ in cells); maxr=max(r for r,_ in cells)
        if minr < line:   # above
            shift=line-1-maxr
        else:              # below
            shift=line-1-minr
        for r,c in cells: out[r+shift][c]=g[r][c]
        # clear original
        for r,c in cells: out[r][c]=bg
        # bar: full-width line, on far side of object from divider, adjacent to far edge
        far = maxr+shift if minr<line else minr+shift
        rbar=far-(1 if minr<line else 1)  # away from divider
        for c in range(W): out[rbar][c]=8
    else:
        minc=min(c for _,c in cells); maxc=max(c for _,c in cells)
        if minc < line:   # left
            shift=line-1-maxc
        else:              # right
            shift=line-1-minc
        for r,c in cells: out[r][c+shift]=g[r][c]
        for r,c in cells: out[r][c]=bg
        far = maxc+shift if minc<line else minc+shift
        for r in range(H): out[r][far-1 if minc<line else far+1]=8
    return out

ok=True
for i in range(4,9):
    ki=G[f'Demo pair {i} input']; vo=G[f'Demo pair {i} output']
    m=f(ki)==vo
    ok&=m
    print(i,m)
    if not m:
        d=[(r,c,f(ki)[r][c],vo[r][c]) for r in range(len(vo)) for c in range(len(vo[0])) if f(ki)[r][c]!=vo[r][c]]
        print(d[:12])
print('ALL:',ok)
